title: Partners | Copper CRM
snippet:
## Join Copper’s Partner Program.
Partner with the only CRM that’s a Recommended for Google Workspace app. Access competitive commissions, exclusive training resources and the opportunity to diversify your service offerings.

### Integration partners
Best for SaaS companies that want to integrate with Copper. We support natively embedded apps, API integrations, co-marketing, marketplace listings, and more.

No there isn't a cost to join, we just require that partners purchase once business license if a demo account is needed. We offer a discount on our listed price.

Apply for Copper's referral and solutions partner program by filling out the form; our team will follow up. The straightforward selection process requires a monthly check-in for the first 3 months, onboarding 1 client in 4 months, and completing a short course on Copper within the first month.

title: developers.apideck.com/apis/crm/copper/connection
snippet:
- You need a Copper account on a plan that includes API access.
- You need to be a Copper **Admin**. Copper states that only Admin users can generate API keys. If you are not an Admin, ask one of your Copper Admins to generate the key, or to give you the Admin role.

Copper uses API key authentication. When you connect through Vault, your key and email address are sent as request headers on every call, as described in [Copper Developer API: requests and rate limits](https://developer.copper.com/introduction/requests.html):
```
X-PW-AccessToken: your-api-key
X-PW-Application: developer_api
X-PW-UserEmail: your-email-address
```
API keys carry no scopes. What the connection can read and write follows the key owner's permissions in Copper.

title: Copper
snippet:
Access requirements
| Pre-Requisites | Status | Comment |
|---|---|---|
| Paid dev account | ❓ | |
| Paid test account | ❓ | |
| Partnership | ❓ | |
| App review | ❓ | |
| Security audit | ❓ | |

- Copper offers both OAuth and API_KEY authentication modes. To use OAuth2.0 with Copper, you must first register your application.
- To register your application, [contact](https://developer.copper.com/introduction/oauth/index.html#:~:text=To%20register%20your,all%20authorization%20flows.) copper.
- You will need to provide the name and purpose of your application as well as a URL to an HTTPS endpoint that will handle the secure callback. You will receive two credentials, client_id and client_secret, required for all authorization flows.
- To generate an API token, in the Copper web app navigate to `System settings` > `Integrations` > `API Keys` and click the `GENERATE API KEY` button.
